_comment: Expectations per site for `page_load.py check`. status is the last run of docs/browser-sites.md (ok, warn, fail; excluded: not judged). max_errors: [error] console entries of an agent navigate on the replay. md: strings `dump --md --js` must contain. task_fails (optional): the failure `check --agent` prints today for the site's task in agent_tasks/; another failure fails the site. Values hold on the archives captured 2026-10-07; tighten them as sites are fixed.
